prompts.warrior: Create a production animation test spritesheet. Reference image supplies identity and hand painted style. EXACTLY 8 full-body poses in regular 4-column by 2-row grid, read left to right top then bottom. Large landscape canvas. Transparent background. No labels/grid/shadows/VFX. Every cell has identical dimensions, camera, scale and floor baseline with generous margins; entire weapon and body inside cell. Same face, brown hair, red scarf, anatomy, costume construction and weapon length in all frames. Characters face screen right in side three-quarter view. Whole connected body painted naturally in every frame, NO dismembered parts. This is ONE character performing ONE chronological attack, not 8 different designs. Frame1 and8 same resting pose. Use ONLY LEFT warrior from reference: silver shoulder and chest armor, blue waist cloth, brown boots, slim straight one-handed sword and gold crossguard. 8 frames: ready, twist torso windup, sword raised back, accelerate slash, down-forward contact, followthrough with blade low-forward, recover, ready. Real closed fingers around hilt with thumb opposing fingers, guard above hand; sword rotates coherently with wrist. Shoulder elbow waist knees participate naturally, connected armor and cloth.
